description: This file defines classes and objects for reading Spark event log files, including handling single and rolling log files, with support for compression and ZIP archiving.

classes.name: EventLogFileReader
classes.description: Abstract base class for reading event log files, providing common methods and interface.

classes.name: SingleFileEventLogFileReader
classes.description: Reads information from a single event log file, with lazy status retrieval.

classes.name: RollingEventLogFilesFileReader
classes.description: Reads and manages multiple rolled event log files within a directory.

methods.name: fileSizeForDFS
methods.description: Gets the size of the file if the underlying input stream is a DFSInputStream.

methods.name: addFileAsZipEntry
methods.description: Adds a file as a ZIP entry into the provided ZipOutputStream.

methods.name: lastIndex
methods.description: Returns the last index of event log files, or None for a single log file.

methods.name: fileSizeForLastIndex
methods.description: Returns the size of the last event log file or the single log file.

methods.name: completed
methods.description: Indicates whether the event log application has completed.

methods.name: fileSizeForLastIndexForDFS
methods.description: Returns the size of the last index file if stored in DFS, otherwise None.

methods.name: modificationTime
methods.description: Returns the modification time of the last log file.

methods.name: zipEventLogFiles
methods.description: Compresses and writes event log files into a ZIP stream.

methods.name: listEventLogFiles
methods.description: Lists all available event log files.

methods.name: compressionCodec
methods.description: Returns the compression codec name if used.

methods.name: totalSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of all event log files.
